category: currency exchange-rate API (fiat and crypto: latest, historical, conversion, time series)

free_tier.stated: Free plan USD 0 per month: 5,000 API requests per month shared by REST and MCP calls, hourly rate updates, latest, historical and conversion endpoints, community support.
free_tier.notes: No credit card is needed to start. The Timeseries API and base currency switching are not on Free or Basic, and a request to an endpoint outside the plan answers HTTP 403. Historical rates go back to January 1, 1996. The next plan up is Basic at USD 10 a month with 50,000 requests a month and 15 minute updates. The former name CurrencyScoop: currencyscoop.com and api.currencyscoop.com answer a 301 redirect to the currencybeacon.com hosts.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-response cap is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: not applicable: a query API with no stored objects; historical rates go back to January 1, 1996

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 5,000 requests a month bound what a free key can pull

interface_detail: GET https://api.currencybeacon.com/v1/{endpoint} (latest, convert, historical, timeseries, currencies) with the key as an api_key query parameter or as a Bearer token in the Authorization header; JSON answers. An MCP server on the same account shares the request quota.
tooling: any HTTP client; code samples for cURL, JavaScript, Python and PHP; an MCP server
chaining: 5,000 requests a month of hourly fiat and crypto rates with history back to 1996, so a free stack caches the latest rates once an hour and converts locally; UniRateAPI gives a daily quota instead of a monthly one.

limits.value: 5,000 API requests per month on the Free plan, shared by REST and MCP calls

limits_note: Plan gating: Free is hourly updates and the latest, historical and conversion endpoints; the Timeseries API and base currency switching are not on Free or Basic. Bulk path: none; each call is one request.
binding_note: The 5,000 requests a month cap is the only limit stated for the Free plan.

identity_cost.detail: The register page asks for a first name, a last name, an email, a password of at least 12 characters with uppercase and lowercase letters, a number and a symbol, a confirmation and a terms checkbox, or Log in with Google or GitHub; it states that no credit card is required.

reliability_note: Past the request volume the API answers HTTP 429; an endpoint outside the plan answers HTTP 403; a call with no key answered HTTP 401 auth failed.
confidence_note: The plan, quota, update rate and endpoint gating are read from the first-party pricing and documentation pages; a keyless call answered HTTP 401 and the old CurrencyScoop hosts answered a 301 redirect. A free key was not exercised, so the answer past 5,000 requests is unverified: behind a sign-up.
